verdict.rationale: Medusa is a headless commerce platform driven entirely through REST APIs with full OpenAPI specs. It has an official CLI and a Cloud CLI that can be scripted, and the Cloud offering deploys from GitHub with instant previews on PRs, which supports CI-driven automation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running the CLI non-interactively in CI pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions examples, auth tokens for headless use), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
